_comment: Paste at https://api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From a manifest. The Tracker only posts, so chat:write and chat:write.public are the whole grant — no reading, no history, no socket mode, no events subscription. After Install to Workspace, copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-…) and run scripts/agents/connect-slack.sh; it never goes in the repo.
